+---
+title: Simple multi-head attention
+---
+
+# Simple multi-head attention
+
+`cudnn.gnn.mha_simple` applies scaled dot-product multi-head attention to a
+homogeneous or bipartite graph represented by `cudnn.gnn.CscGraph`.
+
+For every CSC edge from source node `j` to destination node `i`, it computes
+
+```text
+score[h, i, j] = dot(query[i, h], key[j, h] + edge[i, j, h])
+```
+
+An optional per-head edge weight multiplies the score, optional dimensional
+normalization divides it by `sqrt(dim_head)`, and an optional edge bias is
+added. Softmax is applied across the incoming neighbors of each destination.
+The normalized coefficient aggregates `value[j, h] + edge[i, j, h]`.
+
+```python
+from cudnn.gnn import CscGraph, mha_simple
+
+output, attention = mha_simple(
+    graph,
+    key_features,
+    query_features,
+    value_features,
+    edge_features=edge_features,
+    num_heads=4,
+    return_attention_weights=True,
+)
+```
+
+## Inputs and options
+
+- `key_features` and `value_features` have shape
+  `(num_src_nodes, dim_node)`.
+- `query_features` has shape `(num_dst_nodes, dim_node)`.
+- Optional `edge_features` has shape `(num_edges, dim_node)`.
+- `dim_node` must be divisible by `num_heads`.
+- `concat_heads=True` concatenates the head outputs. When false, the heads are
+  averaged.
+- `norm_by_dim=True` scales logits by `1 / sqrt(dim_head)`.
+- Optional `score_bias` and `score_weight` are FP32 tensors with shape
+  `(num_heads, num_edges)` in direct CSC edge order.
+- Optional `dropout_mask` contains caller-generated FP32 inverted-dropout
+  factors with shape `(num_heads, num_edges)`. It uses mapped edge order when
+  `graph.map_csc_to_coo` is present.
+
+When `return_attention_weights=True`, the function returns
+`(output, attention)`. `attention` contains normalized pre-dropout coefficients
+with shape `(num_heads, num_edges)` and FP32 dtype. It remains differentiable,
+so a loss may depend on the output, the returned attention, or both.
+
+## Backward options
+
+Set `deterministic=True` to use deterministic source-node reductions. The graph
+must first contain reverse-CSC metadata, for example:
+
+```python
+graph = graph.with_reverse_csc()
+```
+
+For FP16 or BF16 inputs, `high_precision_dgrad=True` asks the backend to compute
+key, query, value, and edge gradients in FP32. PyTorch separately controls the
+dtype used to accumulate leaf gradients.
+
+## Availability
+
+The loaded cuDNN backend must provide `cudnnGnnMhaSimpleForward` and
+`cudnnGnnMhaSimpleBackward`. The operation requires an Ampere-class GPU or
+newer and is not available on Windows.

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+
+"""PyTorch custom operation and public API for cuDNN simple MHA."""
+
+from typing import Optional, Tuple, Union
+
+import torch
+from torch import Tensor
+
+from ._dtypes import TORCH_DTYPE_TO_CUDNN, TORCH_INDEX_DTYPE_TO_CUDNN
+from ._utils import require_backend_symbols, tensor_pointer, validate_csc_graph
+from .graph import CscGraph
+
+
+def _validate_inputs(
+    offsets: Tensor,
+    indices: Tensor,
+    map_csc_to_coo: Optional[Tensor],
+    key_features: Tensor,
+    query_features: Tensor,
+    value_features: Tensor,
+    edge_features: Optional[Tensor],
+    score_bias: Optional[Tensor],
+    score_weight: Optional[Tensor],
+    dropout_mask: Optional[Tensor],
+    num_src_nodes: int,
+    num_heads: int,
+    concat_heads: bool,
+    norm_by_dim: bool,
+    csc_rev_offsets: Optional[Tensor],
+    map_rev_to_coo: Optional[Tensor],
+) -> Tuple[int, int, int]:
+    num_dst_nodes, num_edges = validate_csc_graph(
+        offsets,
+        indices,
+        map_csc_to_coo,
+        num_src_nodes,
+        csc_rev_offsets,
+        map_rev_to_coo,
+    )
+    if num_dst_nodes > 0 and num_edges == 0:
+        raise ValueError("cuDNN MHA Simple does not support a nonempty destination set with zero edges")
+
+    if not isinstance(num_heads, int) or isinstance(num_heads, bool):
+        raise TypeError(f"num_heads must be an int, got {type(num_heads).__name__}")
+    if num_heads <= 0:
+        raise ValueError(f"num_heads must be positive, got {num_heads}")
+    if not isinstance(concat_heads, bool):
+        raise TypeError(f"concat_heads must be a bool, got {type(concat_heads).__name__}")
+    if not isinstance(norm_by_dim, bool):
+        raise TypeError(f"norm_by_dim must be a bool, got {type(norm_by_dim).__name__}")
+
+    dtype = key_features.dtype
+    if dtype not in TORCH_DTYPE_TO_CUDNN:
+        raise TypeError(f"features must have dtype float32, float16, or bfloat16, got {dtype}")
+    feature_tensors = [key_features, query_features, value_features]
+    if edge_features is not None:
+        feature_tensors.append(edge_features)
+    for tensor in feature_tensors:
+        if not tensor.is_cuda:
+            raise ValueError(f"features must be CUDA tensors, got {tensor.device}")
+        if tensor.device != offsets.device:
+            raise ValueError(f"all graph and feature tensors must be on {offsets.device}, got {tensor.device}")
+        if tensor.dtype != dtype:
+            raise TypeError(f"all features must have dtype {dtype}, got {tensor.dtype}")
+
+    if key_features.ndim != 2 or key_features.shape[0] != num_src_nodes:
+        raise ValueError(f"key_features must have shape ({num_src_nodes}, dim_node), got {tuple(key_features.shape)}")
+    dim_node = key_features.shape[1]
+    if tuple(value_features.shape) != (num_src_nodes, dim_node):
+        raise ValueError(f"value_features must have shape ({num_src_nodes}, {dim_node}), got {tuple(value_features.shape)}")
+    if tuple(query_features.shape) != (num_dst_nodes, dim_node):
+        raise ValueError(f"query_features must have shape ({num_dst_nodes}, {dim_node}), got {tuple(query_features.shape)}")
+    if dim_node == 0 or dim_node % num_heads != 0:
+        raise ValueError(f"node feature dimension {dim_node} must be positive and divisible by num_heads ({num_heads})")
+    if edge_features is not None and tuple(edge_features.shape) != (num_edges, dim_node):
+        raise ValueError(f"edge_features must have shape ({num_edges}, {dim_node}), got {tuple(edge_features.shape)}")
+
+    expected_score_shape = (num_heads, num_edges)
+    for name, tensor in (("score_bias", score_bias), ("score_weight", score_weight), ("dropout_mask", dropout_mask)):
